name: grok-code-playground
description: Grok Code — branded VS Code shell + embedded Grok Build + optional Claude Code terminal + MCP bridge (Windows, macOS, Linux/Ubuntu)

scripts.install:all: npm run install:bridge && npm run install:mcp && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:bridge && npm run build:mcp
scripts.package: npm run package:bridge && npm run package:ui
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:no-copilot && npm run test:new-tools && npm run test:agents && npm run test:platform && npm run test:mcp
